prompts.text: Build the example_cw_tx runnable example (.grc+.kyt+demo+README) proven vs a Python golden.

notes: EXAMPLE: CW/Morse transmitter (text->keyed envelope, ITU-R M.1677). SRAM-backed: Morse table off-array in the panel as run-records; CWKeyer player is 2 cells on-chip. Envelope BIT-EXACT (Q15) vs the ITU-R golden over PARIS/SOS/'CQ CQ DE KYTTAR' on the REAL built bitstream; timing 1:3:1:3:7 exact, Hann click-edge 0 LSB. Ships .kyt + .grc + .py + cw_tx_demo.py + golden + README + test (8 tests). TX half of a planned CW transceiver.
